name: Nuance DAX Copilot
description: Nuance DAX Copilot (Dragon Ambient eXperience Copilot) is Microsoft's enterprise-grade ambient AI clinical documentation solution. It automatically captures the patient-clinician conversation and generates clinical notes directly in the EHR. Powered by Microsoft Azure OpenAI, DAX Copilot is designed for large health systems requiring deep EHR integration and enterprise security.

faqs.question: How much does Nuance DAX Copilot cost?
faqs.answer: DAX Copilot is enterprise-priced and requires a custom quote. Typical pricing ranges from $200-400 per provider per month with volume discounts for large health systems. Implementation fees and multi-year contracts are common.

faqs.question: Does DAX Copilot integrate directly with Epic?
faqs.answer: Yes, DAX Copilot has native, deep integration with Epic and writes documentation directly into the EHR without copy-paste. It also integrates natively with Cerner, MEDITECH, Allscripts, and other major EHRs.

faqs.question: How is DAX Copilot different from Dragon Medical One?
faqs.answer: Dragon Medical One is primarily a dictation solution where clinicians speak their notes. DAX Copilot is an ambient AI that listens to the patient conversation and generates notes automatically without dictation. Many organizations use both together.

faqs.question: Is DAX Copilot HIPAA and HITRUST compliant?
faqs.answer: Yes, DAX Copilot is fully HIPAA compliant with BAAs available, HITRUST CSF certified, SOC 2 Type II certified, and built on Microsoft Azure's enterprise security infrastructure.
